parameters.name: data_width
parameters.description: Select the DQ width of DDR3 16 or 8, default is 16

parameters.name: freq
parameters.description: DDR running speed in Mhz from 100 to 400 Mhz, default is 400.

parameters.name: col
parameters.description: Column Address bit width. Default: 10. Value changes based on DQ width and memory size. Refer DDR3 SDRAM Addressing section in DDR3 JEDEC spec.

parameters.name: row
parameters.description: Row Address bit width. Default: 16. Value changes based on DQ width and memory size. Refer DDR3 SDRAM Addressing section in DDR3 JEDEC spec.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Bank Address bit width. Default : 3. This should typically be set to 3 to align with 8 bank support in DDR3 devices.

parameters.name: rank
parameters.description: Number of rank. Fix to 1.

parameters.name: simulation
parameters.description: Set to yes to generate example test for simulation, set to no to generate example test for hardware test. Default is No

parameters.name: burst_length
parameters.description: Burst length. Fix to 8.

parameters.name: read_burst_type
parameters.description: Set the read burst type sequential or interleaved, default:  sequential.

parameters.name: cas_latency
parameters.description: Set the CAS latency (CL) 5 or 6, default is 5. 800D and 800E both support 5 and 6.

parameters.name: dll_reset
parameters.description: DLL reset function. Fix to yes.

parameters.name: write_recovery
parameters.description: Write recovery (tWR) value. Fix to 6.

parameters.name: precharge_pd
parameters.description: Pre-charge power-down function. Fix to on.

parameters.name: dll_enable
parameters.description: DLL enable, fix to true.

parameters.name: output_drive_strength
parameters.description: Set the output drive strength value rzq/6 or rzq/7. Default is rzq/6.

parameters.name: al
parameters.description: Set the Posted CAS Additive Latency (AL)  value disable or cl-1 or cl-2. Default is disable.

parameters.name: qoff
parameters.description: Output enable function. Fix to enable.

parameters.name: rtt
parameters.description: Set the On-die Termination (ODT) Resistance value disable, rzq/2, rzq/4, rzq/6, rzq/8, rzq/12. Default is rzq/6.

parameters.name: cwl
parameters.description: CAS write latency (CWL) for 800D and 800E fix to 5.

parameters.name: asr
parameters.description: Enable auto Self Refresh function (ASR). Fix to disable.

parameters.name: srt
parameters.description: Set the self refresh temperature (SRT) normal or extended. Default is normal.

parameters.name: dynamic_odt
parameters.description: Set the Dynamic On-die Termination (ODT) disable or rzq/2 or rzq/4. Default is disable.

parameters.name: mpr_rf
parameters.description: Multipurpose register (MPR) read function. Fix to 0

parameters.name: mpr
parameters.description: Set the multipurpose register normal or enable. Default is normal.

parameters.name: tCL
parameters.description:
CAS latency in CK.
Default: 5.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tCWL
parameters.description:
CAS write latency in CK.
Default: 5.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tAL
parameters.description:
Additive latency in CK.
Default: 0.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tCCD
parameters.description:
Command to command period in CK.
Default: 4.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tRTP
parameters.description:
Read to precharge period in CK.
Default: 4.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tWR
parameters.description:
Write recovery time in CK.
Default: 6.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tRCD
parameters.description:
Activate-to-internal read/write delay in ns.
Default: 13.125.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tRAS
parameters.description:
Activate-to-precharge command period in ns.
Default: 37.5.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tREFI
parameters.description:
Maximum average periodic refresh in ns.
Default: 7800.Depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification, maximum support is 7800.

parameters.name: tRC
parameters.description:
Activate-to-activate/refresh command period in ns.
Default: 49.5.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tRFC
parameters.description:
Refresh-to-activate/refresh command period in ns.
Default: 350.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tWTR
parameters.description:
Delay from start of internal write transaction to internal read command in
CK.
Default: 4.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tMRD
parameters.description:
Mode register set command cycle time in CK.
Default: 4.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tRP
parameters.description:
Precharge command period in ns.
Default: 13.125.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tMOD
parameters.description:
Mode register set command update delay in CK.
Default: 12.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: ODTH8
parameters.description:
ODT high time with write command and BL8 in CK.
Default: 6.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tXS
parameters.description:
Exit self refresh to commands not requiring a locked DLL in ns.
Default: 360.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: usReset
parameters.description:
Powerup init reset low period in μs.
Default: 200.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: usCKE
parameters.description:
Powerup init CKE low period in μs.
Default: 500.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: tZQinit
parameters.description:
ZQCL command: Long calibration time in CK.
Default: 512.Value depend to DDR3 800D and 800E specification.

parameters.name: arbiter_init
parameters.description: Select to prioritize write(0) or read(1) operation: Default is 1.

parameters.name: arbiter_count
parameters.description: Set the number from 1 to 16 to set make the ddr3 doing setting time of read or write command before switching priority to write or read command. Default: 8

parameters.description: DRAM GROUP

parameters.description: DRAM_WIDTH

parameters.description: WFIFO_WIDTH

parameters.name: DM_BIT_WIDTH
parameters.description: DM_BIT_WIDTH

parameters.name: write_leveling
parameters.description: Write leveling function. Fixed to disable

parameters.name: tdqs
parameters.description: Termination data strobe (TDQS). Fix to disable

parameters.description: RC

parameters.description: WR

parameters.description: RP

parameters.name: CWL_temp
parameters.description: CWL

parameters.name: DDR3_DATA_RATE
parameters.description: Select the DDR3 Data Rate 800D or 800E, default is 800D

parameters.name: DDR3_MODE
parameters.description: Select the DDR3 interface Native or AXI4. Default is AXI4

parameters.name: READ_ENABLE_PIPELINE
parameters.description: Additional pipeline on top of Memory Read Latency value. Please refer to Userguide for details.
